overview: Two 1940 cross-reference sheets: Kobe reports Japanese gold exports in early 1940 were under one-sixth of 1939's total, and Grew's November telegram analyzes Japan's gold position as of November 1, 1940.

people.name: Tourley
people.role: Reporting official at Kobe; full identity and position are not stated

people.name: Joseph C. Grew
people.role: U.S. Ambassador to Japan; identified from the apparent OCR misreading of the attribution to telegram no. 168

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to report on the decrease in Japan’s gold exports
subfiles.about: The sheet refers to a report stating that Japan’s gold exports in the first half of 1940 were less than one-sixth of its total exports in 1939.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference: Kobe reports Japanese gold exports in the first half of 1940 fell below one-sixth of 1939's total.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to telegram no. 168 analyzing Japan’s gold position
subfiles.about: The sheet refers to telegram no. 168 presenting an analysis of Japan’s gold position as of November 1, 1940.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference: Grew's November 1940 telegram analyzes Japan's gold position as of November 1, 1940, filed under 894.515/70.

interest: Shows Japan's shrinking 1940 gold exports and a 1940 Grew assessment of Japan's gold position, pre-freeze.
